## v0.7.1 — Privacy toggle works again

A small update to v0.7.0 that gets another feature past StoryGraph's Cloudflare
block.

### Fixed

- **Making a book private or public** works again. The plugin now reads and sets
  it through the shelf page instead of the blocked book page. This applies to
  books on the "Currently Reading" or "Paused" shelf; other books still fail.

### Still limited

- The **edition picker list** has no reachable source: search shows one edition
  per work, and the editions page is blocked. Switching editions works when the
  target edition is known.
- This remains a workaround for a block on StoryGraph's side. If Cloudflare
  changes its rules, it can break too. Details in the
  [roadmap](https://github.com/dkuester/NickelStorygraph/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

### Tested

- Privacy, with a real session: a book on the shelf set to private and back to
  public.
- The device test of v0.7.0 is done and v0.7.0 works on the device. v0.7.1 only
  changes the CLI.

### Installation

| Firmware | File(s) |
|---|---|
| **4.x** (Kobo) | Copy `KoboRoot.tgz` to `.kobo/` and eject |
| **5.18 and newer** (Kobo, Tolino) | Unzip `NickelStorygraph-adds.zip`, copy `NickelStorygraph/` to `.adds/`, **then** copy `Kobo.tgz` to `.kobo/` and eject |

An existing `config.ini` is kept. From v0.7.0 it is enough to replace `cli` in
`.adds/NickelStorygraph/`.
